target.artifact: host-integrated live claim attempt receipt emitter

canonical_identity.problem: claim attempt receipt schema and fixtures exist but live create-if-absent winner loser outcomes are not automatically persisted by the worker claim flow
acceptance: a live multi-worker canary produces durable receipts whose winner loser counts reconcile with actual claims and failed attempts
lost-existing receipts resolve winning claim ref and commit when observable and record no overwrite decision true
real claim flow emits append-only claim_attempt receipts for won lost_existing and host_error based on host results
receipt emission failure cannot change claim authority or overwrite outcome and credential payloads are excluded
